SQL 123 needs check_intake_items with its deposit and return columns, the check_stage labels 'deposited' and 'returned', checkalt_deposits, check_audit_log and check_billing_events (spec prerequisites; the labels are checked by the file, 42704 sql123_check_stage_label_missing; a read-only production inspect confirms the rest). The one-time move touches only checks the inspect counts as checkalt_approved_checks_to_move.
